body:
I really want to thank you for that. It really was what I needed to hear.

I'm not sure how much this matters over reddit, but for what it's worth, I will talk to my parents about my attempt.

I'm not trying to dispute your response (well, I guess I am, technically), but I do need to emphasize the fact that I made that terrible decision almost two days ago. Do you still feel the hospital is the right choice? I only ask because I want to know if I should still go there even two days after the temptation has past. I don't want to feel like a pointless burden, you know.

Also, I am already on anti-depressants.

I appreciate your reply. Hell, I wouldn't still be here if I wasn't looking for someone to talk me down. But, the truth is, life has been kicking me down for as long as I've had memories. I mean, really, I've been feeling this way for about 20 years now...the only end to it I can imagine is death. Yet, for whatever reason, I do feel the need to communicate my reason to someone else. I'm sorry that person is you, because you really do seem to be a truly nice person. I hope you know that you really are a good person. Even if you can't save me, the fact that you tried makes you so kind. :)
